description: A kid that two members of different families carry fails with MultipleMatchingKeys; decided by ADR 0054 §2.5 (kid): both members carry kid dup, and with no alg or key_use nothing else is checked, so two match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
